attchmntText: Lakshmi Finance & Industrial Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication the un-Audited Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter and Half year ended   30.09.2026, published on 11.11.2026 in the Business Standard (in English) and Nava Telangana (in Telugu).
voiceSummary: Lakshmi Finance and Industrial Corporation Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 10, 2026. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the company recorded a net loss of 161.87 lakh rupees, compared to a net loss of 123.58 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at minus 5.40 rupees, down from minus 4.12 rupees previously. Total income from operations was 57.91 lakh rupees, significantly lower than 147.19 lakh rupees in the prior year period. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 242.48 lakh rupees, compared to 250.89 lakh rupees in the corresponding period of the previous year. Earnings per share for the half year were 8.08 rupees, down from 8.36 rupees. The equity share capital remains at 300.00 lakh rupees with a face value of 10 rupees per share.

attchmntText: Lakshmi Finance & Industrial Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lakshmi Finance and Industrial Corporation Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 10, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 161.87 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net loss of 123.58 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 242.48 lakhs, versus a net profit of 250.89 lakhs for the corresponding period in the previous year. Earnings per share stood at negative 5.40 for the quarter and 8.08 for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 6,213.07 lakhs. The trading window for designated persons, closed since October 1, 2026, will reopen on November 12, 2026.
